metaDescription: Sentry is an application monitoring platform for errors, performance tracing, session replays and logs. See its features, Developer, Team, Business and Enterprise pricing, strengths and limitations.
overview: Sentry is an application monitoring platform that captures errors, performance traces, session replays and logs from your apps, then groups them so developers can find and fix problems faster. It supports most major languages and frameworks.

Pricing is event-based: each plan includes a base volume per data type, such as errors, replays and logs, and you can add more with discounted reserved volume or a pay-as-you-go budget. The Developer plan is free forever, and the Business plan has a 14-day free trial with no credit card.

features.title: Error monitoring
features.text: Capture errors with stack traces and context, grouped into issues.

features.title: Tracing
features.text: Follow requests across services to find slow code and bottlenecks.

features.title: Session Replay
features.text: Watch replays of user sessions to see what led to an error.

features.title: Logs and metrics
features.text: 5 GB of logs and 5 GB of application metrics included on every plan.

features.title: Flexible volume
features.text: Add reserved volume at a discount, or set a pay-as-you-go budget.

features.title: Many SDKs
features.text: SDKs for most major languages and frameworks, web and mobile.

useCases: Seeing what users did before a crash
strengths: Errors, tracing, replays and logs in one place.
Pay only for the data you send, with reserved volume discounts.
A 14-day Business trial with unlimited event data.
limitations: The Developer plan is limited in features and volume.
Event-based pricing needs monitoring as your traffic grows.
Extra logs and metrics beyond 5 GB cost $0.50/GB.
Advanced features need Business, at $80/mo or more.
Usage beyond plan quotas needs a pay-as-you-go budget.

pricing.summary: Free Developer plan. Paid plans include a base volume per data type; you can add reserved volume at a discount or set a pay-as-you-go budget. Prices below are billed yearly; monthly billing costs more.
